sentence: From 2022-02-23 to 2026-11-24 (239 weekly decisions, both traded at the open), labels set with the pre-market price returned +39.2% a year (worst drawdown -37.7%) against +32.3% (-44.6%) for labels set at the previous close; the two agreed on 89% of stock-weeks. Sharpe ratio difference +0.16 (95% block-bootstrap CI [-0.04, +0.36]): deciding before the open has been **not distinguishable from deciding on the previous close**.
